notes.title: Demo Patch Changelog (v.0.8.9)
notes.content:
Here are some adjustments we've made for the latest demo build:

[b]Improvements:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved overall gun mechanics.
[*] Separated gun ammo amount and durability bar. Guns won't disappear when ammo reaches zero.
[*] Improved enemy projectile hit reactions & damage points, making them more accurate based on body parts.
[*] Improved overall camera system, making it more dynamic.
[*] Improved overall combat system. Players no longer stick to enemies like a magnet when attacking; they must manually move and direct attacks at specific targets, making combat more dynamic & fluid. Various minor improvements.
[*] Improved enemy AI combat behavior. More aggressive & increased difficulty.
[*] Improved HUD UI.
[*] Improved overall lighting & post-processing FX.
[*] Improved overall sound FX volume balance.
[*] Improved footstep sound FX.
[/list]

[b]Changes & Fixes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed buttons sometimes not reacting when pressed.
[*] Fixed music sometimes not playing in combat mode.
[*] Fixed some floors not making a sound.
[*] Fixed projectiles floating when firing a gun.
[*] Fixed animations playing on their own without enemy reactions.
[*] Fixed inconsistent enemy counter targeting.
[*] Fixed enemy dead bodies blocking other enemy AI navigation.
[*] Fixed some invisible wall collision exploits (still under review).
[*] Changed dodge animation to be more grounded & realistic in combat.
[/list]

[b]New Additions:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new finisher moves.
[*] Added new counter moves.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=UG8k1YHlvhM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for playing our demo!

We hope that you enjoyed playing the game.
-Eksil Team

notes.title: Acts of Blood X Machine56
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
Happy New Year!
We hope you enjoyed your holiday.

Opening this year, we have some exciting news,
We're happy to announce our collaboration with Machine56.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052738/a58c8ec9ac28c850f6b2b7818ff97957d3264408.png[/img]

Machine56 or M56 for short, is a renown streetwear brand from Bandung-Indonesia, the same city as Eksil Team. We on Eksil Team, are big fans of their works. Seeing that they always trying to create the best product for their niche audience. The same value that we're trying to build on Eksil Team. 
So we met a while back, had a fun discussion, and decide to collaborate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052738/c5b90b120be4df1b7102048213d78627fb5db759.jpg[/img]

For our early collaboration, now you can play as Hendra while adorning a stylish MS-Bomber D1 jacket and Runner_01BK pants. Both items can be equipped from Outfit Selection in-game on this demo. 

We plan to add more outfits in collaboration with Machine56 in the future. 
 
Both item are official merhandise that can find on [url=https://www.machine56.com/]Machine56 website[/url]

[i]* Fun Fact: Fajrul is a huge fans of M56, in fact some of his earlier works are heavily inspired from them.[/i]

Aside from the collaboration announcement, we also have a small tweak to our battle system, Changelog are as follows:
[list]
[*] Improved attack counter to be more responsive
[*] Improved motion warping
[*] Improved attack timing
[*] Improved enemy ai
[*] Improved camera movement
[*] Improved Hendra's head model
[*] Added 1 new outfit set
[*] Added M56 outwear & bottoms
[/list]
We hope you enjoyed playing our game. 
We'll also post our update on our social media from time to time.

-Eksil Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052738/0a045960c0574ad9fe8513812ef995626083d6f9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo build for Acts of Blood is Live Today
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
First, we’d like to thank you for supporting Acts of Blood.
We are excited to Announce that the Demo build for Acts of Blood is Live now. 

About Acts of Blood:
Acts of Blood is a fast paced and intense action beat 'em up game, with a strong focus on hand-to-hand combat and using weapons to take down enemies. There's also Destructible environments, melee and firearms weapon choices, and basic parkour movements.

What you can expect on the Demo build:
[list]
[*] Play through one of the main story arcs (Jagal Arcs)
[*] Outfit Customization - You will be able to change the wardrobe, so they can fight with the outfit that they’ll like.
[*] Arena Mode - Test your skills in the arena by fighting waves of enemies
[*] Unlock Achievements and complete various challenges, including reaching specific ranks in the arena and other combat feats.
[/list]
Watch the trailer here
[previewyoutube=gBC1PT6UrJ0;full][/previewyoutube]

Any feedback would be really appreciated!
And don’t forget to wishlist our game!


Follow us on social media to stay updated on the game.
